name: Headway Provider Platform
short_description: Provider enablement platform that handles insurance credentialing, billing, and client referrals for independent mental health clinicians, allowing therapists to accept insurance without administrative burden.
long_description: Headway is a leading provider enablement platform that helps mental health clinicians build insurance-based private practices without the traditional administrative headaches. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York City, Headway has raised over $200 million in funding and works with over 25,000 therapists and psychiatrists across all 50 states. The platform handles insurance credentialing (typically 4-8 weeks), claims submission, payment processing, and patient referrals. Clinicians maintain their independent practice and set their own schedules while Headway manages the insurance complexity. Headway is in-network with major insurance carriers including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare/Optum, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans. Providers receive reimbursement rates typically ranging from $80-150+ per session depending on license type, location, and payer. Headway takes approximately 10% of each session as a platform fee. The platform also provides a patient directory and matching system, bringing new clients to providers. For clinicians wanting to accept insurance without joining a large telehealth company, Headway offers an attractive middle ground of infrastructure support while maintaining practice independence.
one_liner: Insurance credentialing and billing platform enabling therapists to build independent insurance-based practices.

faqs.q: How much do Headway therapists make per session?
faqs.a: Headway providers typically receive $80-150+ per session after Headway's approximately 10% platform fee. Actual rates depend on your license type, location, insurance payer, and session codes. Psychiatrists and prescribers typically receive higher rates. Payment is processed via weekly direct deposit.

faqs.q: How long does Headway credentialing take?
faqs.a: Headway insurance credentialing typically takes 4-8 weeks depending on the insurance panels and your state. Headway handles all the paperwork, follow-up, and communication with insurance companies. You can start seeing self-pay clients immediately while waiting for credentialing.

faqs.q: What does Headway take from each session?
faqs.a: Headway takes approximately 10% of each insurance reimbursement as a platform fee. This covers credentialing, claims submission, payment processing, patient referrals through their directory, and ongoing support. There are no upfront costs to join.

faqs.q: Is Headway worth it for therapists?
faqs.a: Headway is valuable for therapists who want to accept insurance without dealing with credentialing paperwork, claims submission, and billing complexity. The ~10% fee is often worth it for the administrative time saved and steady client referrals. However, cash-pay practices or those with existing billing infrastructure may not need Headway.
